pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit rounded to sub-polygonal geometry with low-frequency edge gradients; spatial area of patches is highest on the hindquarters and decreases/fragments near the anterior neck region due to overlapping textural anomalies.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnecting grid of high-luminance pixels forming continuous pathways between dark patches; junction nodes are primarily triradiate; pathway width is high and relatively uniform across the posterior flank.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Extensive, raised, dark-gray masses with a hyper-keratotic, cauliflower-like texture covering the upper neck and shoulder regions; discrete nodular lesions are also visible on the lower flank and ventral area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Widespread presentation of nodular and plaque-like skin lesions across the cervical and thoracic regions, causing significant disruption to the natural pelage pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least seven avian symbionts (oxpeckers) distributed across the dorsal ridge and lateral skin lesions.
